title: Prevent unexpected navigation
summary: A local app window should not become an unrestricted browser for unknown content.
introduction: A local app window should not become an unrestricted browser for unknown content. Your task: Try a link in your local page and observe the policy.
learningObjectives: Try a link in your local page and observe the policy.
Explain the example for prevent unexpected navigation

blocks.text: A local app window should not become an unrestricted browser for unknown content. Navigation can be blocked when the app only needs its bundled page.

Use a local Electron project with electron installed as a dev dependency and main.cjs as its main file. Run with npx electron . after creating package.json and index.html. These APIs do not run in a web-page playground.
Read the code step by step

items: `preventDefault` stops the event's normal browser action, such as a form loading a new page. Your code must provide the intended response.
`setWindowOpenHandler` decides whether a page may create a new window. This simple local utility denies the request.

blocks.text: The app denies renderer-driven page navigation and new-window requests for this simple local design.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: If external links are needed, allow only carefully checked destinations through a narrow main-process action.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Try a link in your local page and observe the policy.
